_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEP8sJsHTL5SDW67Pnz2s2C)_
Fixes #35352
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Branch note (Duplicate Fix Guard): `claude/project-thread-aiqy89` is the branch the card thread's harness assigns and the only one this thread may push, so the repo's `claude/issue-35352-*` spelling is not available; the card's `Claim:` comment names this branch for both halves.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改两个测试文件,不动规则、页面或任何运行时代码。① `os validate --strict` 退出码测试里那条流程的 http 节点补上 `timeoutMs: 10000`;② 展示应用冒烟里 "ungrouped + related-heavy" 用例先用顶栏按钮把侧栏固定在页面旁(Keep sidebar open),再在 900 px 窗口检查记录页是单栏,断言一条没改。
- 为什么改:两处都是测试过期,不是产品回归。① #35244 新加的「http 节点没写超时」警告按 #34776 的定案本就让 `--strict` 失败,命中了旧夹具;② #35187 按裁决 6973617688 让侧栏在 768 px 以上收起时完全隐藏(卡 #35062 验收:「销售应用里收起侧栏后，左边没有图标列，列表和记录页多出对应宽度。」),780 px 窗口的记录页因此拿到整窗宽度变成两栏。
- 风险与回滚:两个文件都不进发布包(cli 只发运 `dist`,showcase 是 private),打 `skip-changeset`;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` 的 "ungrouped + related-heavy" 用例开头(推导注释与新增的固定侧栏三行);`packages/cli/src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts` 中 `calloutFlowSource` 的 `call` 节点。
- 两分钟验证:`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 10 passed (10)`(先建 `@objectstack/cli^...` 闭包)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

### Half 1 (cli `--strict` exit pins)

`packages/cli/src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts` only. The conversions-only minimal pair (`calloutFlowSource`) authored its callout node as `config: { url: 'https://example.com/hook' }`. Since the `flow-http-timeout-missing` warning landed (f4dbcc21), that node raises a warning, and `--strict` promotes every warning, so:

- the conversions-only case met `warnings: [ flow-http-timeout-missing ]` where it pins `warnings: []`;
- the canonical control (`type: 'http'`, converts nothing) exited 1 where it pins 0 on both faces.

The rule and its effect on `--strict` are the ruled behaviour (the missing timeout is a warning, and like every warning it makes `os validate --strict` exit 1), so the fixture is what was stale. The node now sets `config: { url: 'https://example.com/hook', timeoutMs: 10000 }`, the same value the rule's own hint and the showcase http nodes use. The pair again differs in one value only (the node `type`), so each case is decided by what it pins: the converting member by `conversions` alone, the canonical member by nothing. The doc comment above the fixture now says why the timeout is there, so a later edit does not drop it.

The test-only probe that converts `probe_old_callout` to `http` rewrites `type` alone (`{ ...node, type: 'http' }` in `packages/cli/test/fixtures/live-conversion-probe.mjs`), so `config` reaches the lint unchanged. The green run measures this: the converting member's `warnings` is `[]` after conversion.

No other fixture in the file builds a flow: `WARNS_SOURCE`, `CLEAN_SOURCE` and both `severityPairSource` members carry no flow node, and their cases were green before and after the change.

### Half 2 (showcase smoke)

`examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`, the "ungrouped + related-heavy: flat details and the related panels on Contoso" case only. It now docks the sidebar the way a reader does: the app bar's trigger (`[data-sidebar="trigger"]`) floats the menu, and its "Keep sidebar open" (`sidebar-keep-open`) keeps the 256 px sidebar beside the page. It does that at a 900 x 800 window instead of 780 x 800, and asserts the control reads `aria-pressed="true"`. The derivation comment is rewritten from measurement and quotes ruling 6973617688 verbatim. Every assertion of the case is unchanged, the `stack` expectation included.

Why: `756aba29` (#35187, which delivered card #35062) made a collapsed console sidebar hide fully from 768 px up, including the automatic fold below 1416 px. So at 780 px the record view went from 732 px (window minus the 48 px rail) to 780 px (the whole window), over the 760 px `RECORD_PAGE_TWO_COLUMN_MIN_WIDTH` floor. That change was asked for. Card #35062 acceptance: 「销售应用里收起侧栏后，左边没有图标列，列表和记录页多出对应宽度。」 Ruling 6973617688: "Both collapsed states hide the sidebar completely: the manual collapse (`UnifiedSidebar` `collapsible="icon"`) and the automatic fold between 768 px and the record-drawer threshold (#27593, `consoleSidebarRail.ts`, below 1416 px). No icon column remains."

Changeset: none. `skip-changeset`, because `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `"private": true` and the diff is one e2e spec, so nothing publishes.


## Tests

### Half 1

- Red before the change, on `3819afec` (= `origin/main`): `Tests 2 failed | 8 passed (10)`. The two failures are the nightly's two, both naming `flow-http-timeout-missing` on flow `strictexit_notify` node `call`.
- Green after the change, on `e57fc3a0`: `Tests 10 passed (10)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: `Tests 6140 passed (6140)`, exit 0.

### Half 2

- Bisected by measurement. The Console was Vite-built from each `ui/` tree, and the backend was held at `3819afec`, because `756aba29` is a `ui/`-only diff. Readings at a 780 px window, in a fresh context:
  - `958ee035`: `stack`, page root 732, rail gap 48, `main` x=48.
  - `9c29d732` (= `756aba29^`): `stack`, page root 732, rail gap 48.
  - `756aba29`: `two-column`, page root 780, rail gap 0, `main` x=0.
  - `3819afec`: `two-column`, page root 780, rail gap 0.
- Re-derivation at `3819afec`, fresh context:
  - 640 to 759: `stack`, view = window (phone shell).
  - 760 to 1415: two-column or wide, view = window, sidebar hidden.
  - 1416 and up: sidebar expanded, view = window - 256, which is at least 1160.
- Re-derivation with the sidebar docked (UI path and seeded preference agree, and the dock survives a reload): view = window - 256. 1015 gives `stack` (759); 1016 gives `two-column` (760).
- Phone-shell candidates rejected: at 720 and 740 px the tier assertion passes, but the case fails at the Invoices body-table cell (`element(s) not found`).
- Spec at `6406f211`: `e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` gives 3 passed (19.2s). Before the change, at `3819afec`, the case fails at line 191: Expected "stack", Received "two-column".
- Full smoke on the final head `5ed4dd78`: `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` gives `56 passed (1.8m)` of 56, 0 flaky, skipped or failed; `Tests 1 passed (1)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0; `✓ 4 … detail-shapes.spec.ts:161:5 › ungrouped + related-heavy … (3.7s)`.

## Acceptance notes

- Three sibling cli e2e fixtures carry the same timeout-less http node (`test/build-json-failure-conversions.e2e.test.ts`, `test/lint-conversion-notices.e2e.test.ts`, `test/validate-json-failure-conversions.e2e.test.ts`). None of them is among the failing files of nightly run 44465977675, so the warning moves nothing they pin. Not changed here.
- This file runs only in the nightly `e2e` tier, so the PR that added the warning could not see this fixture go red. Noted, not filed.
- The nightly's "first red" at `958ee035` (run 44245072315) was a different spec, `e2e/live/phone-nav-drawer-back-29131.spec.ts` (8 failed). Detail-shapes passed that night (`✓ 4 … detail-shapes.spec.ts:161:5`). Its first red is run 44465977675 at `81c09477`, so the window is `958ee035..81c09477`, not `d57d6eed..958ee035` as the card thread's claim 7001438925 read it (this corrects that claim).
- No fresh-context desktop window draws the stack tier on a full record page any more. Only a docked sidebar (768 to 1015 px), the split pane / record drawer, or the phone shell do. The case keeps the desktop shell through the docked sidebar. Alternatives not taken: a phone-shell window (it changes the details' related rendering, so other assertions would have to change), or the split pane (it restructures the case).
- Changeset: none for either half, label `skip-changeset`. `@objectstack/cli` ships `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, so its `src/**/*.e2e.test.ts` publishes nothing; `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `"private": true`.
